course_summary:
ISEN 620 | Survey of Optimization | Fall 2025
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 2:20 PM - 3:35 PM | ETB 2026
Grading: Exams [20%], Homework Quizzes [15%], Lecture Quizzes [5%] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker Conditions, Conjugate Direction Methods, Newton's Method, Steepest Descent Method, Root Finding, Line Search, Simplex Method in Matrix Form, Complementary Slackness, Graphical Method, Simplex Method: Termination & Initialization, Simplex Method: An Introduction, FONC for Equality Constraints, Second Order Optimality Conditions, FONC for Unconstrained Problems, classical optimality conditions, LP Duality: Introduction, IP Modeling, LP Modeling, Sensitivity Analysis, Analysis of the Simplex Method, LP Assumptions, unconstrained nonlinear optimization, constrained nonlinear optimization, linear programming theory, nonlinear programming theory, linear programming, nonlinear optimization, numerical methods, optimization models, small-scale optimization problems, large-scale problems, optimization software, deterministic linear optimization, deterministic nonlinear optimization, LP Basics, Nonlinear Opt.: Preliminaries, Constrained Optimization
Tools: AMPL, Excel, Canvas, Zoom, GroupMe
